answers.acts: It publishes what it sells, sets up a service once its set-up is paid with an order (delivering a system to an organisation), offers the service agreement, and switches its systems off when the agreement ends or is not paid for. It takes no requests.

boundary.why: What assistants can do, at what speed, how often they slip, at what price and on what terms, is the outside world's technology on offer, as world prices are. A provider of the outside world stands for it at the world's edge, as it is held in the profile with its source; nothing in the town can know or change it otherwise, and nothing here sets how much anyone delegates.
